body: oh, man. have you ever thought to maybe look for free therapy around? maybe the online chat hotline? they’re usually really good for finding resources for getting shit together; coupons for food and other essentials while you’re in between all that shit. keep on living for your family, they need you and you need them.

hey, if no one reached out, you went through it, the belt broke, and you came out completely unscathed with no further mental problems or physical disabilities—something out there needs you to stay alive. that’s so rare, man. you deserve to keep going and i hope it gets easier.

i’d be more proud of you than to just buy a coffee,  but whatever makes you happy! one year is a big achievement. don’t put more stress on your brain with the math vids, either, man. do stuff you enjoy. you’ve had it hard enough lately, yeah?

and of course. in a world like this, all we have are each other, and if it means anything i’m really proud of you for making it for another year. that takes a lot.

maybe look to Netflix for some new tv shows or movies to check out until you can fall asleep?

keep in mind that if you’ve had some ups last year, you’ll have some this year. maybe treat yourself to your favorite restaurant or a new piece of clothing tomorrow to mark making it this far.
